t: What Energy Storage Comparison Database Is All About
title: What Energy Storage Comparison Database Is All About
description: Storage is rated by power (MW), energy (MWh), duration (hours), and round-trip efficiency: lithium-ion (90%+, 2-4 hours, the solar-shifter), pumped hydro (80%, 8+ hours, 95% of capacity), flow batteries (decoupled power/energy, long duration), compressed air, and thermal. Levelized cost of storage ($/MWh) decides. The grid needs all durations — no single technology covers them. This database is the complete storage technology: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
